mapper.select: SELECT 0 AS position,'payment_unknown' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(submitted_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT submitted_at FROM tc_payment_attempt FORCE INDEX(ix_attempt_observation) WHERE status='UNKNOWN' ORDER BY submitted_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_payment_unknown UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS position,'refund_held' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_payment_refund_hold FORCE INDEX(ix_hold_observation) WHERE state='HELD' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_refund_held UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS position,'refund_submitted' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_payment_refund_hold FORCE INDEX(ix_hold_observation) WHERE state='SUBMITTED' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_refund_submitted UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS position,'callback_pending' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(received_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT received_at FROM tc_payment_callback FORCE INDEX(ix_payment_callback_observation) WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY received_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_callback_pending UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS position,'callback_review' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(received_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT received_at FROM tc_payment_callback FORCE INDEX(ix_payment_callback_observation) WHERE status='REVIEW' ORDER BY received_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_callback_review ORDER BY position
